summary: Residential kerb with homes 13-20 m across front yards; cars park nearby.

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 14-19 m back from the kerb at this section, behind front yards and trees.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street; few cars parked on this side, but there is room to stop.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street between two junctions.
drivers.convention: Cars park on the opposite kerb; this side has fewer.

sun_shade: Partly shaded by street trees on the south side, mainly in the morning.

best_section.where: Goldsbrough Road south kerb, mid-block under street trees
